name: lynkgrids
description: LinkedIn prospecting and outreach from your chat: find leads by ideal customer, check your connections, enrich contacts, run connection-plus-follow-up campaigns, and triage replies in the Lynkgrids CRM.

interface.shortDescription: LinkedIn prospecting, outreach and a CRM, run from chat.
interface.longDescription: Lynkgrids finds the people you sell to on LinkedIn, keeps them in a CRM, and runs the outreach: a connection request, then follow-ups, paced to keep the account safe. From chat you can describe an ideal customer and get leads, score your own connections against it, enrich contacts, launch a campaign on a list, and handle replies.
defaultPrompt: Find 50 Heads of Sales at B2B SaaS companies in India and add them to a list.
Check my LinkedIn connections and put everyone who fits my ideal customer into the list Q4 founders.
Who replied to my campaigns this week, and draft replies for them.
